title: Add tie-breaking logic and footer credit

requirements.summary: Implement tie-breaking logic for leaderboard rankings: when two or more golfers have the same net score, rank the golfer with the lower gross score higher
acceptanceCriteria: Golfers with identical net scores are sorted by gross score in ascending order
The golfer with the lower gross score appears higher in the leaderboard rankings
Tie-breaking logic applies consistently across all leaderboard displays

file_operations.description: Update the sorting logic in the leaderboard calculation to implement tie-breaking: when net scores are equal, sort by gross score in ascending order. Modify the sort comparator that currently sorts by net score only to add a secondary sort condition on gross score.

requirements.summary: Add footer text 'designed by Dancing Skeleton, LLC' to the application footer
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays 'designed by Dancing Skeleton, LLC' text
Text is visible on all pages of the application
Footer maintains existing copyright and attribution information

file_operations.description: Add the text 'designed by Dancing Skeleton, LLC' to the footer component. Preserve the existing copyright year and 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution. Position the new text appropriately within the footer layout to maintain visual balance.
